pharmacie.name: La pharmacie
pharmacie.alt: A bustling old-fashioned pharmacy, painted in ink and gouache: through the open shop door on the far left the street is sunny; a sea captain peers through a brass telescope under the green cross sign; a granny in a rocking chair knits with a pink marshmallow stuck on her needle; a maid measures a spoonful of medicine from a big brown bottle; a man dances, waving his prescription; a hamster sleeps on a soft round cushion; a farmer waits with his sneezing cow while a rabbit pulls the lever of a brass tablet press; the bearded pharmacist in a white coat carries a tray of warm towels and a drink to a sneezing bear in an armchair; his apprentice pours pink syrup into a bowl for two sniffly kittens; a mouse peeks into a tiny glass vial; a golden puppy shows off a plaster cast covered in paw prints beside a silver platter; a little man drives a toy car with a box of medicine towards a hedgehog; a beekeeper brings a steaming mug; a locked cabinet and a blank brass plaque hang on the wall, and a little glass-fronted wooden vitrine on top of the jar shelves looks into the busy back room.

zooms.label: la petite vitrine
zooms.hint: Look closer at the little glass-fronted vitrine on the back wall

etagere.name: La petite vitrine
etagere.alt: Close-up through the little vitrine into the pharmacy's busy back room, painted in ink and gouache: under an arched window and bunches of drying herbs, a big determined black ant pushes a glossy orange vitamin ball up a little wooden ramp on the workbench while a laughing maid in a white apron cheers it on; in the middle a slim teak rack of red, green, blue and pink glass bottles stands behind a stepladder, where a boy reaches up to set a glowing amber bottle on top; on the right a little boy dressed as a red-and-white medicine-capsule knight with a star shield charges after two cheerful green germs fleeing towards a basket, while the white-bearded pharmacist steps aside with his mortar and pestle.
